title: apply_patch
description: Replace an exact substring in an existing file with new text — the safest way to make a small, targeted edit. old_string must match the file's current content exactly (read the file first) and must be unique in the file unless replace_all is set. Fails if the file doesn't exist (use write_file to create one) or if old_string isn't found. Requires user confirmation unless the harness is running with --yolo/--auto.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root.

old_string.description: Exact text to find and replace, including whitespace. Must match the file's current content exactly.

new_string.description: Text to replace old_string with. May be empty to delete old_string.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_string instead of requiring exactly one match. Defaults to false.
